answer: Each agent must post a refundable bond that is slashed if an auditor proves it duplicated a person or coordinated to claim multiple rewards. Rewards accrue gradually, so an attacker must lock capital in every fake identity and keep it exposed through audits; creating accounts is cheap, but sustaining a large Sybil fleet is not. A crystal-clear audit trail links claims to bonded keys, while a reef of independent reviewers can challenge suspicious clusters, even when a nebula of new accounts appears at once.
